reviews.t: Better than the natural brushes
reviews.x: I don't know where that guy is coming from, but these brushes are the best you can buy.  Most body brushes are natural fiber that doesn't stand up very well in the shower because they get mold easily.  These brushes are strong enough to exfoliate and soft enough to get in the most sensitive places without any ouch.  They clean easily and dry quickly without having to worry about mold.  I've had mine for about four years and it is like new.  I have bought them as Christmas presents and have had g

reviews.t: Not Really Fuller Brush
reviews.x: These brushes are just junk - I bought one which lasted less than two years. Fuller brushes used to last forever.  And forget any of the 'satisfaction  guarantees' they talk about on their web site - they only guarantee their brushes for one year. Net: Look elsewhere for your brushes before you waste your money on Fuller brushes.  The company that is called Fuller Brush today is not even close to the company that made Fuller Brushes  20 years ago.

reviews.t: ... purchased this brush as a replacement to a dearly loved Fuller body brush that lasted for years
reviews.x: I purchased this brush as a replacement to a dearly loved Fuller body brush that lasted for years.  Although this new brush has the right contours and feels great, after a couple of uses the wire that holds the bristles and connects the brush to the handle has started to rust.  It took many years for the Fuller brush to begin rusting and I'm afraid the longevity of this new brush is questionable.

reviews.t: A proper bath brush that's worth the money
reviews.x: This brush is a dream. The first time I showered with it, I could tell that A LOT of thought had gone into the design, particularly the brush's contours. The slightly curved figure eight shape allows me to reach everything that matters and do it efficiently. Yes, it looks like a toilet scrubber--but it's also the best bath brush I've ever used. With respect to stiffness, the bristles fall somewhere in the middle; they're rigid enough to exfoliate, but not so much that they tear or irritate my se

reviews.t: Close to "ORIGINAL" Stanley, but no cigar!
reviews.x: The "ORIGINAL" Stanley bathbrush had bristles a tad harder than this current one made now and called Original.  Furthermore; the "ORIGINAL" Stanley bathbrush had a straight handle that was  much stiffer than the current hollow plastic one, which gives you the impression that it will break if you try to brush yourself harder to compensate for the softer bristles that are made now.  If you need a bathbrush, this one will serve you decently well; but, its not as good as the truly &#

reviews.t: Love my back brush.....
reviews.x: I have been looking for this particular back brush for quite some time now. I love the size of it and the bristles are perfect. Not so hard that they rip your skin off, but stiff enough to feel like you're getting a good scrub. My only complaint is the handle.....like others have said it is real slippery when it's soapy and wet and the smooth plastic makes the thing hard to grip. Thus only 4 stars. Overall, it's great!

reviews.t: GREAT BODY BRUSH!
reviews.x: For the last few years I have always purchased the Fuller Foot & Body Brush and have always been pleased with the firmness of the bristles.  I saw the Original Bath Brush and very pleased with this brush even though the bristles are not as firm as my previous purchase.  I use this brush all over, feel very clean, and invigorated after my shower.

reviews.t: No stiffy here
reviews.x: Well I guess I'm a real scrubber.  Others have described this brush as having VERY stiff bristles.  That, a long handle, and some longevity were exactly what I was looking for.  The handle is fine, though slippery; the longevity will probably be great because I'll be buying a different one; the stiffness I will call disappointing at best.  Perhaps I should narrow my search to "metal bristles".

reviews.t: Perfect length for small spaces, perfect softness to stiffness ratio!
reviews.x: I bought this brush for my mom who has mobility issues and was needing something to reach both her back and her legs and feet. This brush is working very well for her. She has a small walk in shower and uses a bath bench in the shower so there really isn't a lot of room. The length of this brush allows her to reach everywhere she needs without it being cumbersome in such a small space. She also commented on it's softness. To me it seems soft enough for more delicate body parts while definitely b

reviews.t: Better suited to toilet cleaning IMHO
reviews.x: I bought this for use in the shower as a body scrubber. Overall I was very disappointed.  Handle: There were burrs along both sides of the handle that made it very uncomfortable to hold. The length was great but the odd bend near the end essentially make the handle 3" shorter. You can't grip the handle by the bend and exert any force on the brush. The handle is very thin and the material is very slick, which combine to make it hard to hold with soapy hands. The contour of the handle does not len

reviews.t: While references are made to Original fuller brush, this ...
reviews.x: While references are made to Original fuller brush, this brush is not the same as the "original fuller brush". This brush is a "knock off" most likely Chinese. All Legit fuller products, have their logo embossed somewhere on the product, something this brush lacks. I have owned the original, and noticed straight away, that the bristles were inferior, and would not last long. After a month of use they were, and it didn't. know what you are buying here!

reviews.t: Removes even spray sunscreen!
reviews.x: I bought this to get a day’s worth of spray sunscreen off my skin,  and it does the job nicely. No other back brush-type product has been able to do that.  I still think the price is too high for a back brush—even one that works—but at least it’s doing what I bought it to do.  I’ve had it only a week, so if it rusts as some others have noted it might, I will amend this review.

reviews.t: Very disappointed to see what was a good name brand end ...
reviews.x: 1 Day old and while I am using one of the sharp metal ends pulls out of the end of the handle and put a 9 scratch across my back...Very disappointed  to see what was a good name brand end up making this rubbish..

reviews.t: It was so bad we threw it out
reviews.x: The bristles are so soft, they collapse completely during use.  The handle does not allow you to reach your whole back.  It was so bad we threw it out.

reviews.t: Liked it from day 1.
reviews.x: Have had this brush in my shower at least two years now and will get another if it ever wears out.  The long handle allows one to wash lower legs, feet, and back with much less bending and twisting than a hand held item.  The spiraled brush design also allows cleaning between toes and in crevices vs. the flat or one sided brushes.  The bristles are soft enough for the more tender areas but firm enough for all over (not the scrub brush type of bristles).  I would recommend this item to anyone and

reviews.t: NO WAY...
reviews.x: No way can this $25 back brush be an authentic Stanley product. I've had two in the last 7 months and BOTH have flattened bristles! At that price it should be of top quality, has to be a knock off, this is the second time I've gotten burnt from Amazon. (shame shame)

reviews.t: This brush is firm enough but not too rough so ...
reviews.x: This brush is firm enough but not too rough so it doesn't cause pain. I just wish the handle was longer without the curve at the end. I would give it 5 stars IF the handle were longer.

reviews.t: DON'T BUY
reviews.x: Handle broke cleanly in two on second use.  Very bad product!  Bought much better brush at drug store for $5.00.  By all means, save your money!

reviews.t: Too Soft. Handle too long. Not the same ...
reviews.x: Too Soft . Handle too long.  Not the same as I remember from the 60's .

reviews.t: Not as stiff as I would've preferred.
reviews.x: I had hoped this brush would have stiffer bristles than the ones in the stores. They are - but only slightly. And while my back doesn't itch as much now that I have this to scrub with instead of the wimpier ones, I would still prefer a much stiffer bristle. Something that actually makes it feel like you're getting dead skin off and preventing bacne. (Back acne for those unfamiliar with the term.) This does not feel like it's doing that. Makes me wish that the days of the door to door Fuller Brus

reviews.t: Wish I would have found this years ago
reviews.x: I have bought various brushes over the years to scrub my back, etc. in the shower and never really found one that worked well.  This Bath brush is great for reaching your back and anywhere else.  The bristles are not rough, but are strong enough to clean.  The way it is designed it drys thoroughly so you do not seem to get the mildew like you do on many of these brushes.  I would definitely buy this again!  Glad I found this.

reviews.t: Best product of its kind
reviews.x: I have had a Stanley back scrubber for many, many years. My mother was a Stanley Home Products dealer back in the 1950s through the 1970s. All their products are of excellent quality. I have purchased a few other back scrubbers over the past 10 years or so - not aware that I could still purchase one made by Stanley. Best one I've ever owned.

reviews.t: It's very effective and dies a great job of cleaning the body (mainly & usually the back).
reviews.x: The Fuller Back brush has a wonderful design!  It's easy to use and can be turned over for a different angle. It cleans the back it etc. very well. No blackheads or wHite heads after prolonged use. Very nice, brush softens after a few showers.

reviews.t: My husband declares it to be "The best backbrush ever"
reviews.x: After 15+ years of use, our Stanley Home Products Luxury Bath Brush bit the dust.  We were thrilled that the same style brush is still available.  Probably should have ordered two . . .  We highly recommend!

reviews.t: Fuller makes the Best Back Brush!
reviews.x: Best Bath Brush ever!  Long brush head with soft bristles and a long, easy to hold handle.  Exactly what I have been looking for.  I just ordered another for the beach house!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the brush's design and reach, saying the long handle and contoured shape make it easy to wash the back, legs, and feet.
Bristle firmness is divisive: some find the bristles perfect for scrubbing, while others say they are too soft and collapse during use.
Several reviewers complain about the handle, describing it as slippery, burred, or awkward to grip.
Durability and quality concerns appear repeatedly, including rusting wire, a metal end pulling out, and the brush being called a knock-off of the original brand.
Some reviewers find the price too high for a back brush, though others consider it worth the money.
